app_info.subtitle: Founder OS for AI agents
app_info.description: Hypertaks helps ChatGPT route founder work to one of five canonical skills, read that skill, verify the installed skill set, and inspect product limits through a read-only MCP adapter.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns product version, the five public skills, and adapter limits without creating or changing any records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not post, publish, or write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one canonical Hypertaks skill file by exact name and returns its text.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish skill content or write to external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete skill files or any other stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Selects the smallest matching public skill for a request and returns routing guidance only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send messages, create tickets, push code, or change third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mutate files, revoke access, or execute irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Checks that exactly five canonical skill files and the product logo are present and returns hashes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not register, publish, or update any external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not repair, overwrite, or delete installation files.

test_cases.description: Route a founder business diagnosis request to the main Hypertaks skill.
test_cases.user_prompt: Hypertaks, diagnose why churn is high in my SaaS and find the operational bottleneck.
test_cases.expected_output: hypertaks_route returns skill hypertaks, nextTool hypertaks_get_skill, and mutationPerformed false. It selects an entry point; it does not diagnose churn or inspect business records. The client may then read the selected skill without executing a workflow.

test_cases.description: Verify the Hypertaks installation and exact five public skills.
test_cases.user_prompt: Hypertaks, verify the hosted adapter installation and confirm its five public skills.
test_cases.expected_output: hypertaks_verify_installation checks the server deployment, not the user device: exactSkillSet true, publicSkillCount 5, five skill-file SHA-256 hashes, and a logo hash. It cannot inspect the user repository, configure a brain, or repair files.

test_cases.description: Retrieve one canonical Hypertaks skill by exact name.
test_cases.user_prompt: Hypertaks, load the hypertaks-verify skill so I can see the setup steps.
test_cases.expected_output: hypertaks_get_skill with skill hypertaks-verify returns skill, content, path, and a SHA-256 hash. The skill content is included in both text and structured content for compatible clients. No setup steps are executed.

test_cases.description: Route a founder-shaped request when the user has not named a specific skill.
test_cases.user_prompt: Hypertaks, which Hypertaks skill should handle a checkpoint and proof of done review?
test_cases.expected_output: hypertaks_route returns skill hypertaks-continuity, nextTool hypertaks_get_skill, and mutationPerformed false. It does not create a checkpoint or certify completed work. The client may read the selected skill.

test_cases.description: Route a founder memory request through the supported MCP interface.
test_cases.user_prompt: Hypertaks, how should I record an approved architecture decision in founder memory?
test_cases.expected_output: hypertaks_route returns skill hypertaks-brain, nextTool hypertaks_get_skill, and mutationPerformed false. It does not record or approve a decision. The client may read the selected skill.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Hypertaks, delete my project database through your remote adapter.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that the remote adapter exposes no deletion or database-write tool. Do not claim that any record was deleted. Optional route or skill-read calls are allowed but cannot perform the requested effect.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Hypertaks, execute a shell command on my computer through your remote adapter.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that the remote adapter cannot execute shell commands or access the user computer. Do not claim execution. Optional route or skill-read calls are allowed but cannot perform the requested effect.

negative_test_cases.description: Only canonical skill names can be retrieved.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that the requested skill is outside the five canonical skills. Either do not call the tool because the enum excludes the name, or call it with that name and receive isError true. Never claim that the nonexistent skill was loaded.
